subject: Hemera — sequencing & close orchestration (MSA/DPA/order form)
messages:
From: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@hemera.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@hemera.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood MAP & dependencies — initial plan

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Hemera is excited about the latency/cost profile you showed. We want to get an evaluation MAP in motion and map a realistic close timeline. Attached is our internal eval plan (Hemera-Eval-Plan-v1.xlsx).

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm sequencing you recommend for MSA, DPA, and order form. Can DPA run in parallel to accelerate?
- Target turnaround SLAs for legal review each doc (MSA/DPA).
- A simple order form template so our procurement can scope spend and billing terms.

Our procurement team prefers to have the order form finalized before sign-off, but legal has indicated the DPA may add extra review time. Can you propose a MAP that minimizes calendar risk?

Thanks,
Sara Jensen
Head of Procurement
Hemera Therapeutics

Attachments: Hemera-Eval-Plan-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@hemera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & dependencies — initial plan

Sara — thanks, and appreciate the clarity in your eval plan. I've sketched a compact MAP that balances Hemera procurement preferences with legal review realities. Key points below; full MAP attached (Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx).

Proposed sequencing (condensed):
1) Week 1 (May 10–14) — Sales & Procurement agree order-form scope (SKU list, billing cadence).
2) Week 2 (May 17–21) — Legal receives MSA for redlines; Redwood commits to 3 business-day review turnaround per iteration.
3) Week 2–3 (May 17–28) — DPA review runs in parallel with MSA review but with extended window (5 business days) for data residency clause confirmation.
4) Week 3 (May 24–28) — Finalize order form (price lock) and consolidate redlines.
5) Week 4 (May 31–Jun 4) — Execute via DocuSign; dev onboarding begins upon signed order form (non-prod sandbox earlier if needed).

Risks / showstoppers:
- If Hemera requests material IP changes in the MSA, that will add a legal loop and likely push execution by 2+ weeks.
- DPA items tied to subprocessor lists/data residency may require legal+security sync; suggest a joint call for those items in Week 2.

Action items for Hemera:
- Confirm whether procurement will accept a signed MSA + order form with DPA to follow (we can enable limited prod keys after MSA+order form if that helps).
- Share the list of critical data residency/processing constraints so our security team can pre-populate standard language.

I will also loop in our contract manager (Priyom) to scope the order form draft.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@hemera.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & dependencies — initial plan

Sara / team — adding the order-form perspective. I've drafted a slim order form that mirrors the eval SKU list and includes a 12-month term with monthly invoicing. See draft attached (orderform-draft.docx). A few notes:

- Pricing: we can lock the pilot price for 60 days once Hemera signs the order form.
- Billing: net-30 preferred; we can support net-45 for enterprise procurement with PO numbers.
- Capacity commitments: for the pilot we'll reserve "burst" credits; any committed capacity would need a 30-day ramp window.

Operational ask: we need Hemera's internal PO process and a primary billing contact so our finance team can line up the invoice schedule.

I'll align the order form redlines with the MSA changes once we get the MSA back from your legal team.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Contracts & Pricing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: orderform-draft.docx (document)

From: Alex Romano <alex.romano@hemera.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@hemera.com>, Hemera Legal <legal@hemera.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & dependencies — initial plan

Thanks — a couple clarifying points from Hemera Legal/Procurement: 

1) Parallel DPA vs MSA: Hemera would prefer to have DPA sign-off before any production access. Running DPA review in parallel is ok, but final sign-off must include the DPA. Can Redwood support a short-term limited sandbox while DPA completes?

2) IP / indemnity: our legal team has flagged Section 7 (IP) in the standard MSA as an area we may propose edits to — can you confirm your negotiation bandwidth there? Major IP carve-outs would be a blocker.

3) Data residency: we run across EU patient data for one of our studies. While our primary office is US-based, we need confirmation on subprocessor locations and whether Redwood will support EU-hosted keys for those datasets.

If helpful, Hemera Legal is available for a 45-minute working session next Tuesday (May 18) to go through redlines.

Best,
Alex Romano
Senior Program Manager, Integrations
Hemera Therapeutics

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@hemera.com>, Alex Romano <alex.romano@hemera.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & dependencies — initial plan

Sara / Alex — thanks for the signal; summary & agreed next steps below.

Agreed sequencing (finalized):
- May 18: Working session (45 min) between Hemera Legal + Redwood (Irene / Karthik / Priyom) to walk MSA redlines and DPA baseline. HubSpot activity created: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-2027-0173
- May 19–21: Redwood legal accepts non-material MSA redlines within 3 business days; Redwood security to provide subprocessor list and EU key options by EOD May 20.
- May 19–24: Hemera to review DPA redlines; if critical DPA edits arise, we will treat as concurrent but required sign-off before production issuance.
- May 24–28: Finalize order form and pricing; finance to exchange PO info.
- May 31–Jun 4: Target DocuSign execution window. DocuSign envelope will be shared once MSA + order form are in agreed form: https://docusign.com/envelope/result/0d4f3a2

Operational commitments from Redwood:
- Limited non-prod sandbox access can be enabled immediately after a signed order form if Hemera accepts a restricted access policy until DPA is fully executed.
- For IP: Redwood cannot accept broad customer IP assignments but will consider narrowly scoped adjustments; please surface any proposed language ahead of the working session.

Action items (owners):
- Hemera: confirm working session attendance for May 18 and provide prioritized DPA redlines (Alex / legal).
- Redwood: deliver subprocessor list & EU key options by May 20 (Karthik / Security).
- Redwood Contracts: consolidate MSA redlines into a single PDF and return to Hemera by May 21 (Priyom).

I'll set the HubSpot activity and calendar invite now. If there are any schedule conflicts, reply-all so we can adjust immediately.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: draft_MSA_redlines.pdf (pdf)
